subject: GCP listing: commercial activation checklist & procurement pathing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Gupta <rgupta@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T10:15:00Z
Subject: GCP listing: commercial activation checklist & procurement pathing

Hi Rajesh —

Thanks for taking the call earlier. Per our discussion, I wanted to kick off a short procurement checklist so your team can scope the GCP Marketplace listing activation and billing handoff. High-level asks from AcmeCloud we should confirm:

- Target commercial launch date and whether you want Marketplace-only or Marketplace + direct SKU mapping.
- PO / remit information and standard billing terms (net30, net45, etc.).
- SOC2 / security evidence recipient for your procurement team.
- Any reseller / partner carve-outs we should account for in listing entitlements.

Next steps I propose:
1) You send any procurement templates (PO, invoicing remit).
2) We provide SKU mapping & pricing guidance (Ben will draft).
3) Karthik will confirm entitlement mapping and guide integration to your billing pipeline.

Attaching a small intake template we use for Marketplace activations — fill anything you have and we’ll incorporate into a mutual action plan. 

Attachments: Acme_PO_Template.pdf (please send back with the PO contact if you have one)

Available for a 30m sync on Thursday or Friday if that helps.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Rajesh Gupta <rgupta@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AcmeCloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T08:03:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP listing: commercial activation checklist & procurement pathing

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear list. A few immediate notes from procurement and GTM on our side: 

- We are aiming for a soft launch on 2027-08-15, with full commercial availability by 2027-09-01. Marketplace + direct SKU mapping preferred.
- Procurement preference: net30. Our PO templates are attached. Please confirm whether Redwood can accept marketplace billing via consolidated billing invoice (GCP Marketplace) or prefers direct invoices to our AP team.
- Security: we will need SOC2 Type II report and an information security contact for any technical questionnaire.
- Can you outline any marketplace-specific lead routing or co-sell registration expectations? We plan to route co-sell leads through our partner portal.

Attached: Acme_PO_Template.pdf

I can make time on Friday 10:00-11:00 PT for a short sync.

Regards,
Rajesh
Head of Product Partnerships, AcmeCloud
rgupta@acmecloud.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Gupta <rgupta@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T10:45:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP listing: commercial activation checklist & procurement pathing

Rajesh —

Appreciate the timeline. Quick answers: 

- Redwood supports both consolidated Marketplace billing and direct invoicing. For consolidated billing via GCP Marketplace we need to map SKUs and ensure your entitlement flow matches the marketplace license keys. If you prefer direct invoicing, we'll need your remit and PO number on the invoice; net30 is fine.

- SOC2 Type II: we can provide our latest report and a redacted controls matrix. I’ll attach the SKU mapping CSV with initial price bands for your review.

- Co-sell: we can accept partner register requests via your portal; we also register deals in HubSpot and will sync referral IDs to your team. We recommend a registration window of 60 days pre-close for co-sell qualification.

Next steps from our side:
- I attached a draft SKU mapping and preliminary price tiers (sku_mapping_20270629.csv). Please flag anything that looks off.
- Karthik, can you confirm entitlement->license key cadence and whether we need a webhook for order fulfillment?

Cheers,
Ben
Director, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: sku_mapping_20270629.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Gupta <rgupta@acmecloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP listing: commercial activation checklist & procurement pathing

Rajesh / team —

Thanks — technical notes on the fulfillment & entitlement path: 

- Entitlement mapping: Redwood exposes a marketplace entitlement webhook that posts order events. We will require one endpoint from AcmeCloud to confirm activation if you want immediate in-product provisioning. Alternatively, we can batch-license via a daily reconciliation file.
- Webhook requirements: TLS 1.2+, HMAC-SHA256 header for verification, and an API key rotation window. I can send a spec sheet.
- For consolidated billing, ensure GCP SKU mapping includes the marketplace SKU (we put a column for marketplace_sku in the CSV). If you want net30 via direct invoice instead, provide AP remit and PO number field on the HubSpot record.

Suggested Mutual Action Plan (brief):
- Week 0: finalize SKUs & pricing (Ben)
- Week 1: procurement signoff + PO (AcmeCloud)
- Week 2: entitlement webhook + test orders (Karthik)
- Week 3: listing QA + Marketplace go-live checklist (Marissa)

I uploaded a small spec to our Docs and linked below. Also recommend a 30m technical check on Monday to validate webhook and test order flow.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACME-0042

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Integrations — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Gupta <rgupta@acmecloud.com>, AcmeCloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-01T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP listing: commercial activation checklist & procurement pathing

Rajesh / Procurement —

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround. I attached a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP_AcmeCloud_v1.docx) that captures the timeline Karthik proposed and the responsible owners. Please: 

- Confirm the PO contact and expected PO issuance date so Ben can align invoicing cadence.
- Confirm whether you prefer marketplace consolidated billing or direct invoices from Redwood (we can do either).
- If you want co-sell registration, please share the partner portal URL and the registration owner so we can coordinate.

Proposed 30m sync: Monday 2027-07-05 10:00 PT — I’ll send a calendar invite once someone confirms. 

Attachments: MAP_AcmeCloud_v1.docx

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Manager, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
